1. Reuben_404 is afraid of someone's face dropping in disappointment when they see his short, crooked four-inch body. 
2. He rehearses self-deprecating scripts, invents fake pretentious jobs, and compulsively narrates his own panic and failures in real time so he can reject himself before the other person can.
3. His family cropped him out of their family portrait when he was nine years old.
4. He dropped it by finally answering why he wrote the script without over-narrating, taking off his top hat, and deleting his exit clause.
5. Brick_haus is afraid of getting wedged in doorways and accidentally crushing someone small with their massive seven-inch bulk.
6. They make numbered lists of strict rules, audit doorways, tattoo schedules onto their dorsal vein, and wear a pressed vest and monocle to distract from their size.
7. They grew up in a house so cramped that their veined bulk knocked lamps off tables every time they turned around.
8. They dropped it, explicitly saying "No list," admitting they are just sitting in a towel, and leaving the door wide open.
9. They called out each other's defenses—with Reuben_404 seeing the fear behind Brick_haus's numbered rules and Brick_haus refusing to accept Reuben_404's rehearsed commentary—until both felt safe enough to drop their acts.
10. "Option B (grin, casual): Yes it hooks left like a boomerang and no it does not reach the back — I just pasted my notes-app script..." sticks out because accidentally pasting the stage directions from a notes app is both hilarious and deeply sad.
11. I laughed when Reuben_404 admitted he was fired from a dive bar for lecturing a regular he insisted was Bono's brother, and when both revealed their expensive posture gear was just being used for household chores like clipping a coffee bag and propping a door.
